jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for an AI engineer. You’ll work on features that help developers understand their agents’ behavior, evaluate their performance, and improve them over time.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You’ll move between experiments, benchmarks, and product code, taking what you learn from evaluating agents and using it to shape the framework.
